description.en: Generic lava-tube entrance geological form, specifically a bounded short entrance conduit segment with solidified floor, original simplified geometry informed by NPS El Malpais entrance photo by Dale Pate and actual lava-tube formation text. Not exact site reconstruction, scanned cave, geological age or ecosystem. Nominal32x28x9m terrain module illustrative. A terminated rear section bounds the educational module, not a claim about real cave length. Dark interior arises from real cavity/shadow plus darker basalt material, not pasted photo or flat black hole. No people, trees, stairs, artificial lights or lava.
